balanceAlertsAreTriggeredBasedOn: Balance alerts are triggered based on your Available Credit, which includes your account balance and remaining credit limit.
pleaseSelectAtLeastOneNotification: Please select at least one notification method
theMaximumPostpaidAmountApprovedBased: The maximum postpaid amount approved based on your account’s credit profile, allowing you to consume first and pay later.
theWarningAmountMustBeBetween: The warning amount must be between $1 and $10,000,000, and the interval between amounts with an active warning status must be at least $5.
